brief.claim: Students in the lowest fifth of the autumn test gain at least 5 points on the spring test after the tutoring programme: the claim holds when the mean gain of those students is at least 5 and one-sided one-sample t-test p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: test scores out of 100: test 0 = autumn, test 1 = a second test given just before the tutoring began, test 2 = spring
